data.description:
## Reproduction

1. `.test-index` has any `[test_name]` marker (intentional RED test tolerance)
2. Open any PR targeting main
3. ci.yml's `merge-pipeline-checks` job invokes `plugins/dso/scripts/scan-red-markers.sh BASE_SHA HEAD_SHA`
4. Script reads the MERGED tree's `.test-index` via `git merge-tree --write-tree` and counts `[test_name]` markers
5. Any non-zero count → exit 1 → CI fails → PR cannot merge

## Expected

Scanner should be **delta-aware**: exit 1 ONLY when the merged tree introduces NEW markers vs the BASE tree. Pre-existing markers (already on main) should be ignored — they represent intentional RED tolerances accepted into main earlier.

## Actual

Scanner counts ALL markers in the merged tree. Since main has ~53 accumulated markers from prior work (and the convention permits them as intentional RED tolerances), every PR to main fails this check regardless of whether the PR added any markers.

## Evidence

PR #245 (epic f691-681e):
- Initial PR fail: 52 markers in branch `.test-index` → exit 1 (with marker list in stderr).
- Bulk-strip workaround (commit 8b9a243aad on session-cont-20260519-131000) deleted all 56 marker brackets to unblock merge-pipeline-checks.
- Strip exposed multiple genuinely-RED tests (4 files surfaced so far: test-doc-migration.sh, test-harvest-worktree-guards.sh, test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh, test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh) → broke Script Tests + Python Skill/Doc Tests jobs because those tests had been intentionally marker-tolerated.

## Root cause

`plugins/dso/scripts/scan-red-markers.sh` line 222–224:
```
if [[ "$_marker_count" -gt 0 ]]; then
    exit 1
fi
```

Exits 1 on any positive count. No diff against BASE_SHA's `.test-index` marker set.

## Proposed fix

1. Read BASE_SHA's `.test-index`, extract its marker set (set of `source_file:[marker_name]` pairs).
2. Read merged tree's `.test-index`, extract its marker set.
3. `new_markers = head_markers - base_markers`
4. Exit 1 only when `|new_markers| > 0`. Print only the NEW markers.
5. Add unit tests: GREEN case (no new markers added), RED case (1+ new marker added), edge cases (markers removed from base, markers moved between files).

## Related work

- Found during epic f691-681e (PR #245) merge attempt. SC4(a) implemented `merge-pipeline-checks` umbrella + RED-test-blocker; story-level verifier passed but did not catch the delta-mode gap.
- This bug blocks every PR merge to main until fixed or worked around.

## Scope

P0. Production-blocking. Until resolved, all PR merges require `--admin` bypass or full marker strip + downstream test fixes.
data.title: scan-red-markers.sh has no delta-mode: blocks all PR merges
